verdict.rationale: Sierra documents general guardrail and hand-off configuration (e.g., 'guardrails, tone, and style' via Ghostwriter, and 'hand-off rules' experimentation in Insights) plus release-governance controls like merge approval, but there is no explicit documentation of marking specific topics (legal threats, cancellations, security) as strictly human-only with a guarantee the agent never acts on them. Missing for 10: explicit human-only topic designation feature, enforcement guarantees, audit trail proving no agent action on flagged topics, independent verification of this behavior.
